# DRAFT: Marriage Background Verification in India, Explained Simply

DRAFT sample. Marriage background verification means checking that the main facts in a biodata are true before the wedding. Families usually check identity, education, work, marital status and family details. Done openly and with consent, it protects both sides.

:::composite
Two families in Indore meet through a matchmaker auntie. Both are keen, but neither knows the other well. They agree to share the same set of papers before the roka, and the talk becomes easier, not harder.
:::

## What does verification check?

Most families start with the basics that a biodata claims. Then they decide how deep to go.

### Identity and family

Ask for a government ID with the number masked, or share it through DigiLocker. Nobody should collect or store a full Aadhaar number.

### Education and work

Degree certificates, the offer letter and recent salary slips are the usual papers. Check that the company name is the same on all of them.

:::experience
TODO(Saurabh): what share of verifications find at least one mismatch, and which field it is most often.
:::

## How do you ask without causing offence?

Make the request mutual and early. Say you are sharing the same papers yourselves, and that you ask every family this.

:::callout{type="info"}
Ask before the roka. After the engagement, the same question can sound like an accusation.
:::

## Is it legal?

Checking facts with a person's consent is allowed. Collecting someone's personal data without consent can break the [Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023](https://indiacode.gov.in/act/c058fa9f-eaf0-4ca3-98f1-3443b087bca9/sections), so keep it open.

:::msp-cta{placement="mid"}
:::

## What verification cannot tell you

Papers show facts, not character. A clean result does not promise a happy marriage, so spend time together as families too.

If you suspect fraud, report it on the [National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal](https://cybercrime.gov.in/) or call the helpline on 1930.
